# Ladders (generated by tools/build.js; do not edit)

Rule: Per benchmark: keep the pairs no other pair beats on both score and cost (Fable cost times the profile's weight). The first benchmark listed for a class leads; a pair another listed benchmark shows as beaten is removed. Drop pairs below the floor. Pairs within near_tie of each other in cost count as one step (the higher score stays). Walking up from the cheapest, a pair stays only if it gains at least the tolerance over the last one kept.
Tolerance: 3 points or 60 Elo. Efforts left out: max (EVIDENCE.md finding 1: for Opus and Fable on coding, max is beaten or within 2 points of xhigh at 2.5 to 3 times the cost. It stays available on request.)
Scores and costs are vendor-run benchmark results at API prices; see EVIDENCE.md for their limits.
